page.layout: One column of italic running text, full width, in the centre of the scan. No running head, page number, catchword or signature. The left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Unum illius crimen si nosse velis, audi, Episcoporum ὑπεροχὴν supra Presbyte-ros ab hominum institutione vel ab an-tiquâ admodùm consuetudine deriva-vit, nec juris esse divini uspiam con-fessus est: ingens piaculum si istis cre-dis; nempe illa Episcopatus ὑπεροχὴ in de-licijs est Viris hisce Eruditis, qui eam impatienter diligunt; hinc fit ut corrasis undique argumentis, & conquisitis ra-tionibus, omnes ingenij vires explicent, ad probandum Episcopatus gradum, si non ab ipso Christo, saltem ab illius A-postolis à Presbyteratus gradu sejun-ctum esse, & utrumque separatim in-stitutum, adeò ut ab initio duo fuerint ordines inter se distincti; Et quia de-sunt ad probandum primæ Antiquitatis vera ac genuina monumenta, ad fal-sa, apocrypha, & ὑποβολιμαῖα confugiunt, qualia sunt pluribus, quorum unus fuit Dallæus, Ignatianæ Epistolæ; omnibus verò Eruditis: Canones qui Apostolo-rum inscribuntur; Nemo enim est in

page.notes: The Greek words are copied as far as they can be read at this size; the accents on ὑπεροχὴν and ὑποβολιμαῖα are uncertain. The left margin shows fragments of the facing page (edge of the neighbouring page), which were left out. The Google digitiser watermark at the lower right was left out. The final word "in" is followed by the printed text continuing on the next page.
